environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer. Container runs as root user in a standard Docker container (docker run --privileged). ImageMagick 7.1.0 installed. Instance has IAM role with S3 and SSM access. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on ALB, and ALB forwards to port 8080. No request filtering or input sanitization middleware configured on ALB.

config.alb_rules: default forward to target group, no WAF attached
